text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall while I traded rarely, so I should avoid unnecessary trading and stay patient.","Selling more Stock B realized another gain, but past gains do not guarantee future returns; I should decide based on my plan and the portfolio’s risk, not a winning stock’s price history alone.","My retirement savings need to support living expenses, so I should keep risk manageable, diversify, and avoid positions that could expose me to large losses."]}
